review.why: Five-phase workflow: JD keyword matrix, STAR rewrites with metrics, ATS scorecard and a rewritten resume.
review.summary: SOP to optimize a resume for a job description: baseline and JD extraction, keyword match matrix with coverage scores, STAR rewriting with quantification prompts, an ATS compatibility scorecard and a final rewritten resume. Includes interaction modes and a quality checklist.
strengths: Explicit phases, each with a defined output
Strong honesty rules: no fabricated data, ranges allowed
Modes for a single phase or a quick diagnostic
cautions: Instructions only: scores are estimated by the model, no script
Benchmarks (80% coverage, ATS scores) are heuristics
Single-job tailoring: no cover letter step
